device.name: Unitree G1 29-DOF Dex1 whole-body cylinder task (Isaac Lab)

facts.text: The task is registered as the Gymnasium id Isaac-Move-Cylinder-G129-Dex1-Wholebody with the entry point isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv and the local configuration class MoveCylinderG129Dex1WholebodyEnvCfg
The simulator creates the task with gym.make(task, cfg=env_cfg).unwrapped and calls env.seed(seed), so the user-facing interface is a Gymnasium environment
The control step is 20 ms: decimation 4 at a physics timestep of 0.005 s, i.e. four physics steps per control step
An episode is configured to last 20.0 s of simulated time, which is 1000 control steps of 20 ms
The action is a joint-position target applied to every robot joint (joint_names ['.*']) with scale 1.0 relative to the default joint offset
The policy observation group contains robot_joint_state, robot_gipper_state and camera_image, with corruption disabled and concatenate_terms false
The robot body observation is 87 values: 29 joint positions, 29 joint velocities and 29 joint torques
The gripper observation reads the two joint indices 31 and 29, so the articulation has at least 32 joints
The camera observation placeholder is a (1, 480, 640, 3) tensor
The wrist cameras render 480 x 640 RGB frames at a 0.02 s update period
The task has no termination terms: TerminationsCfg is empty
A reset samples the object pose with x in [-0.05, 0.05] and y in [0.0, 0.05] and resets the scene to its default state
The robot is the G1 29-DOF whole-body configuration with a Dex1 hand, loaded from the USD asset named in the articulation configuration

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's initial state and the fake's update rule is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the fake draws with Python's random.Random and was never compared with Isaac Lab, so the upstream physics trajectory was not validated

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in: it does not run PhysX, rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators or the USD robot model; it only moves two reduced joint targets

the action space is a two-element joint-position vector; the deployed task applies JointPositionActionCfg to every articulation joint (joint_names ['.*']), and the joint count and the joint-position limits come from the USD asset named in robots/unitree.py:538, which is not text in the clone

the observation is a reduced stand-in: the body state is the documented 87 values, but the camera image is 1x2x2x3 instead of the deployed 1x480x640x3 placeholder (tasks/common_observations/camera_state.py:81)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the upstream Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab application was not launched: it needs Isaac Sim 4.5/5.x, Isaac Lab, a GPU and fetched USD assets (README.md:127), and the sim backend was not run

the fake's initial joint values, gain, reward and the truncation bookkeeping are test data, not measured device behaviour; the only sourced timing is the 20 ms control step and the 20 s episode length
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
